|lore=Symbol for the Cloud City Miner's Guild (not affiliated with the Galactic Miner's Guild). Named after the beldons, giant creatures who generate Tibanna gas.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Your [Independent Starship] starships are defense value +2 at Bespin locations. Once per game, if Quiet Mining Colony on table, may simultaneously deploy a unique (•) [Independent Starship] starfighter and matching pilot (for -1 Force each) from your hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

|rulings=* If no matching pair can be found, opponent only verifies Reserve Deck. A judge may be required to verify combined contents of hand and Reserve Deck to check for a matching pair.<ref name="scomp" />
* May search Reserve Deck, then decide to deploy a matching pair entirely from hand (this does not trigger verification).
* May deploy the matching pair from hand only (without searching Reserve Deck).
* The pilot must deploy aboard the starfighter.
* The starfighter may deploy directly to a system or sector, or may deploy aboard a capital starship with capacity (e.g. [[Home One]]), and likewise may deploy landed at a site (if normally permitted, e.g. at a docking bay).
